main_result: For every alpha>0, positive moments of the conditional density cap ||p_{S|R}||_infinity can be unbounded even when (S,R) is an orthonormal projection of two independent cap-one original variables and the joint density cap is <=1. For 0<alpha<2 the explicit N-fragment construction gives E L(R)^alpha >= [2^(1-alpha/2)/(2-alpha)](N-1)N^(alpha-1); for alpha>=2 the moment is infinite.
target_valid_stress_test: With independent Y,Z~Uniform[0,1], Q_N=S^2+Y^2-Z^2 has original-coordinate spectrum {1,1,-1,0} and ||p_Q_N||_infinity<=pi/sqrt(2) uniformly in N, despite the exploding conditional-cap moments.

partner_result_applied.application: For the stress family mu=1 and exact-slope mass m_*=1, so the partner theorem yields ||p_Q_N||_infinity<51.6 uniformly in N.

next_step: Prove the live ratio-packet small-interval/coarea estimate in the original independent coordinates with the residual projection kept inside the same unconditional integral; no conditioning on R and no arbitrary-joint replacement.
